claim_boundary: This qualifies the unmodified publisher APK as a whitebox source-mapped test input. It does not establish a complete reproducible source tree or that a locally rebuilt APK is byte-identical or publisher-signed. A rebuilt APK would be a distinct artifact. It is not a blackbox qualification, four-stage static result, installation or startup result.
